info.title: Statutes of limitations by state: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Statutes of limitations by state: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage: The filing deadline the statute sets for five kinds of civil claims in every US state and DC: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage. Each record gives the period in the statute's own words, the citation, a link to the state's official code site, a verbatim quote, and the date read; where the same text says so, it adds whether the period runs from discovery and any outer limit (statute of repose). Where the official code could not be read, a cell may come from a court opinion that quotes or applies the statute; it is marked S (secondary) and names the court, case and date. Cells with neither are marked U and left blank. No calculator and no deadline arithmetic: tolling and exceptions apply.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
